changes: Play makes the picture move in its own place: the video lies over the picture at the picture's scale, centred like it, and fades in on its first frame; the words, layout and focus stay. Play becomes Pause, Play again on the held last frame; Escape brings the picture back.
Play stays up when the computer's controls fade; nothing autoplays.
A sound button beside Play (the clips carry sound; the browser controls that offered it are gone).

Play on, offered while a clip plays when the next verse's picture has a video: the next clip is fetched ahead, the page turns at the end (verse_navigation source play_on) and the next spread arrives playing. It ends at a verse without a video, on a hand turn or a Contents choice, on Escape, or when the reader is busy with a layer or typing.
Opening the whole-picture view keeps the same video playing, uncropped.
